sn35.108:1.1: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa seyyohamasmīti vā hoti sadisohamasmīti vā hoti hīnohamasmīti vā hotīti.
sn35.108:3.1: cakkhusmiṃ kho bhikkhave sati cakkhuṃ upādāya cakkhuṃ abhinivissa seyyohamasmīti vā hoti sadisohamasmīti vā hoti hīnohamasmīti vā hoti …pe…
sn35.108:3.3: manasmiṃ sati manaṃ upādāya manaṃ abhinivissa seyyohamasmīti vā hoti sadisohamasmīti vā hoti hīnohamasmīti vā hoti.
sn35.108:5.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.108:7.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya seyyohamasmīti vā assa sadisohamasmīti vā assa hīnohamasmīti vā assāti.
sn35.108:12.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.108:14.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya seyyohamasmīti vā assa sadisohamasmīti vā assa hīnohamasmīti vā assāti.
sn35.108:16.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati …pe… jivhāyapi nibbindati …pe… manasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn35.108:16.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.108:16.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
